betNotice: Your turn — choose See, Bet, Raise or Fold.

hint.see: Look at your hand before deciding
hint.bet: Call the stake to stay in the deal
hint.raise: Strong hand — raise the stake to apply pressure
hint.fold: Weak hand — fold to limit your losses
hint.show: Force a showdown to settle the deal

tutorial.info: Here you'll see the deal number, the pot, the current stake, and each player's chips and status (Blind / Seen / Folded / Out). Three Card Brag is a 4-player British vying game played with a 52-card deck and 3 cards each.
tutorial.players: Each player's chip balance and status. Lose all your chips and you're eliminated; the last player with chips wins the match.
tutorial.hand: Your 3 cards. Looking at your hand (See) turns you from Blind to Seen, after which your bets cost double. Hand ranking is Prial > Running Flush > Run > Flush > Pair > High Card.
tutorial.bet: On your turn choose See (look at your hand), Bet (call the stake), Raise (increase the stake), or Fold. When two players remain a Seen player can Show to force a showdown.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game and start over from the beginning.
